feature: FILM-1911 MCP connector GA: the super-admin panels, the guard-failure alert, the no-model refusal

mutations.name: 1911 DB P3 a team owner reads the cross-team panels
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.admin_mcp_check_window(p_days integer) returns timestamptz language plpgsql stable set search_path = '' as $$ begin if p_days is null or p_days < 1 or p_days > 90 then raise exception 'the window must be 1 to 90 days, not %', p_days using errcode = 'invalid_parameter_value'; end if; return now() - make_interval(days => p_days); end $$;

mutations.name: 1911 DB G4 the guard check misses a model call on an external run
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.external_run_model_calls(p_limit integer default 20) returns table (usage_id uuid, run_id uuid, account_id uuid, created_at timestamptz, total bigint) language sql stable set search_path = '' as $$ select u.id, u.run_id, r.account_id, u.created_at, count(*) over () from public.llm_usage_analytics u join public.generation_runs r on r.id = u.run_id where r.mode = 'server' limit greatest(p_limit, 1) $$;

mutations.name: 1911 DB G1 any signed-in user runs the guard check
mutations.sql: grant execute on function public.external_run_model_calls(integer) to authenticated;
